weather_source_missing.title: {name}'s weather data source is missing
weather_source_missing.description:
**{name}** uses `{entity_id}` as its weather data source, but there's no such entity: it may have been deleted, or its entity ID changed.

Until then, the sensor uses its illuminance divider instead of the weather. Choose another source, or none, with **Configure** on the Solar Illuminance integration's page.

weather_source_unavailable.title: {name} has no weather data
weather_source_unavailable.description:
**{name}** hasn't had weather data from `{entity_id}` since {since}, so it's using its illuminance divider instead of the weather.

Check that the integration providing `{entity_id}` is working, or choose another source with **Configure** on the Solar Illuminance integration's page. This repair goes away once there's weather data again.
